title: 捕鱼 Mobile 游戏卡片海鱼动效纠错版（Kling）
prompt: Create a visibly animated, seamless 5-second portrait loop from this tropical saltwater coral-reef scene. Keep the camera and reef fixed. The existing clownfish, blue tangs, butterflyfish, angelfish, and distant reef shark swim clearly through the water in different directions; the large angelfish crosses a noticeable part of the scene, small fish weave between coral, and fins and tails move naturally. All animals remain unmistakable marine fish with realistic fish silhouettes; preserve their colors and do not introduce freshwater fish. Add a few small rising bubbles. Keep all fish inside the frame and return to the original composition at the end.
